purpose: Evidence of the iRodent source annotation defect and the separate corrected-label experiment.
finding: For 305 annotations, the published box equals the extrema of all pose landmarks, including missing landmarks represented as (0,0,0). This incorporates unrelated upper-left background. It is not a COCO xyxy/xywh swap or an EXIF dimension mismatch.

v2_annotation_method.method: Use only annotated landmarks with visibility greater than zero; derive their xy envelope; pad each side by 10 percent of the respective span, minimum 2 pixels; clip to image bounds.
v2_annotation_method.excluded: Fewer than two visible landmarks or zero-area visible geometry.
v2_annotation_method.label_origin: Derived from source pose annotations, never from detector predictions.
v2_annotation_method.limitation: This envelope can cover only a visible head or other annotated part. It does not guarantee a full-body animal rectangle and was not independently annotated by a human reviewer.

contact_sheet.transformations: Resizing and montage; published box in red; visible-keypoint-derived v2 box in blue.

v2_dataset.validation: Structure, provenance, exact hashes, source groups and cross-split pHash threshold 4 passed.
v2_dataset.domain_adaptation: 16 assistant-reviewed training images/crops from rato_close, rato_residuos, canal_residuos and drenagem_chuva. Labels are assisted visual annotations, not independently human-certified ground truth.
v2_dataset.regression_caveat: These clips were already inspected during product development and are regression cases, not a pristine independent deployment test.

model_selection_at_audit: Candidate training and evaluation pending; no candidate performance or promotion claimed by this audit.
metric_protocol: Keep v1 metrics as historical results under the original defective source labels. Evaluate baseline and candidate on the same v2 corrected labels for comparison; v1 mAP and v2 mAP are not directly comparable.
